AdminEvidence.description: Admins only (design §4): where the observation came from.
AdminEvidence.title: AdminEvidence

AttributeBlock.description: Where the product page shows a key; a client renders an unknown block as key/value.
AttributeBlock.title: AttributeBlock

denominator.default: offers in an observed stock state (in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock)
denominator.title: Denominator

AvailabilityState.description: Observed availability of an offer. A failed crawl is never OUT_OF_STOCK (DAT-06).
AvailabilityState.title: AvailabilityState

Capabilities.description: What this snapshot can answer. All explicit: a consumer never guesses from absence.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

CaveatCode.description: Machine-readable caveats; the API renders their text per locale.
CaveatCode.title: CaveatCode

Channel.description: Commercial channel of an observation (PRC-14). Pickup is never dine-in.
Channel.title: Channel

convention.default: gapAmount = other - base; gapPct = (other - base) / base x 100. A positive gap means other is dearer than base; see cheaper.
convention.title: Convention

Context.description: One priced place an item is sold: retailer, channel and optionally a location (§2).
Context.title: Context

Excluded.description: Why a pair row is not counted. Every excluded row carries exactly one (design §7.2).
Excluded.title: Excluded

Group.description: The summary for one ``groupBy`` key, with the cohort rule applied per group.
Group.title: Group

Location.description: A branch or area. No coordinates on the wire.
Location.title: Location

MoneyValue.description: An exact amount at its currency's ISO 4217 exponent, as text plus integer minor units.
MoneyValue.title: MoneyValue

PairGap.description: One context pair's gap on the latest date, or why it isn't counted (design §7.2).
PairGap.title: PairGap

definition.default: index = sum(other price) / sum(base price) x 100 over a fixed basket: the pairs counted on the first date of the window and still counted on each date. Above 100 means other is dearer than base. A point with n < 5 is null; there is no interpolation.
definition.title: Definition

ProfileInfo.description: ``meta.profile``: which profile version is in force, and its size rules (ADR-0008 §1).
ProfileInfo.title: ProfileInfo

Rating.description:
The retailer's published rating on its own ``scale`` (e.g. ``"5"`` for 0-5 stars).

The producer never rescales; consumers compare ratings only on the same scale or after
normalising ``average / scale`` themselves.
Rating.title: Rating

RetailerStatus.description: Coverage of a retailer in this snapshot. Only ``supported`` backs an absence claim.
RetailerStatus.title: RetailerStatus

ReviewState.description: Lifecycle of a match edge (MAT-05, MAT-07).
ReviewState.title: ReviewState

Side.description:
One context's state in a comparison, so a client can say which side is short.

``retailer`` holds the context id: a retailer's sole context has the retailer's id.
Side.title: Side

Size.description: The pack size as published, e.g. ``{"value": "50", "unit": "ml"}``. Never converted.
Size.title: Size

firebase.description: Every route, including unknown paths, needs a Firebase ID token carrying a `role` claim (viewer or admin). Cookies are ignored. Every response is `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.
